instruction: Studio photograph, medium close-up at eye-level. In an indoor space with white vertical wood-paneled walls, a woman in a denim shirt (R2) stands behind a man in a dark blue t-shirt (R1). The woman (R2) wraps her arms tightly around the waist of the standing man (R1) from behind, performing the Heimlich maneuver. Both wear white medical gloves, with the woman's hands clasped over his midsection and the man's hands held near his chest. They both look forward with serious expressions. Bright, even indoor lighting casts soft shadows.
